<?php

    $value++;
    $current = Closure::getCurrent();
    if ($n > 0) return $current($n - 1);
    return $current;
};
$got = $fn(2);
echo ($got === $fn ? 1 : 0), ':', $value, '|';

    }

}

echo ($same == $bound ? 1 : 0), ':', ($same === $bound ? 1 : 0), ':', ($copy == $bound ? 1 : 0), '|';
$cap();
unset($original, $cap, $new);
$bound();
$same();
$copy();
